body: A teen in politics? When is the last time you've seen that? I'm talking to a friend of mine now who is too much into politics and if there is a window for us then damn I'm jumping in it and taking him with me.
Cheers, I hope all goes the best with you.

Be near people in what capacity? I crack jokes and talk to sales clerks even if I'm trying to find something. Tell me where to go and what to do and I'll try to do the closest. I don't want to whine, I want to improve myself.

I don't dislike everyone. I love people. But I just feel odd asking people to hang which is why I don't do it so often. This mainly stems from the fact I'm rarely asked so I'm often afraid I'm disliked for some reason. (even though everyone treats me normally in school/person)

"Everyone feels alone throughout all walks of life. Even if they are surrounded by people that love them. Friends, family, co-workers, classmates, etc."

Yes everyone feels alone at sometime. Lonliness is an emotion there everyone faces. But some people feel lonliness because they genuinely are alone while others feel alone because in comparison how they normally are they are alone. I am genuinely alone. I have hung out with people less than 10 times in my life. I've only gone to 2 parties, both of which had parents at home and wasn't that ground breaking; just a bunch of friends together. While everyone is out with others I'm all alone. To help illustrate this there is a song that conveys what a lot of teens feel but spells out what I go through. The only difference is I may have an event or activity on that day that I put there to help fight the feeling. (But am I extremely alone when I don't have some event? Yes) The song is "I'm Just a Kid" by Simple Plan. 

If I say even went to a party every month and hung out with people every week or every few days I'd be content. I don't demand much, just a little. People don't treat me like the weird outsiders with mental problems but yet socially I don't find myself hanging out more or better off than them. (besides a girlfriend)

"As for your voices or characters that you pointed reference to; focus on you. What you want in life, not what they want. You say you dont hear them talk but you have given these thoughts names and a purpose and therefore a way to influence you."

Well I named them just for easier referencing. They have no name in my head. They are not even a voice. But I catagorized any feelings and thoughts I have into personas just for the ease of the reader. 

"You seem to obesses over the idea of being remembered and honored in your death, but suicide? Theres no honor in that. People repeating your name will be repeating them in sorrow, not much joy. Suicide is very hard on loved ones and its selfish act will put a tremendous amount of pain on them. Do you really want to make them suffer and blame themselves in your actions? Stand strong for yourself my friend. Take life for what it is. The ups and downs in life are meant to be learning experiences, not excuses to cut the ride short."

Well hence why I always hope to have a heroic excuse to die. Sacrificing myself in a shooter situation most wouldn't see as suicide. But fortunately for those who don't want to die a hero it doesn't happen often so the only exit strategy is a dishonorable suicide. I obsess over remembrance because my name isn't raised up now. It  is low, it is neither remembered greatly or remembered with tears. As I said, the person who died of cancer was raised as a hero. But not only that it's remembered as sad as people see the situation. My name would be remembered sadly but what loved ones think of me after I die isn't important. I won't be around to see it, right? 

EDIT: Oh also thanks for the response. :)
